the design science research paradigm is a useful approach to design research and that it has the potential to contribute to the development of design knowledge and practice.

understanding and improving the design discipline and its role in design practice.
the relationship between the design discipline and the scientific study of design.
the relationship between design discipline and design science and how this relationship is changing in the context of the digital age.
